mapper.select: SELECT u.userid AS userId, u. NAME AS NAME, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.small_icon AS photoUrl, u.gender AS sex, u.agent_id AS agentId, su.fullname as agentName, u.birthday AS birthday, u.sign AS sign, u.state AS STATUS, u.account AS account, u.online_status AS onlineStatus, u.grade AS grade, p.PROVINCE_ID AS provinceId, p. NAME AS province, tp. LEVEL AS LEVEL, tp.MasterOrder AS vipLevel, tp.promoter_id AS promoterId, tp.promo_code AS promoCode, tp.charge_sum AS chargeSum, ct.CITY_ID AS cityId, ct. NAME AS city, t.TOWN_ID AS townId, t. NAME AS town, u.phone AS phone, u.club_limit AS clubLimit FROM ( ( ( ( t_user u LEFT JOIN t_player tp ON u.userid = tp.player_id ) LEFT JOIN t_province p ON tp.province_id = p.PROVINCE_ID ) LEFT JOIN t_city ct ON tp.city_id = ct.CITY_ID ) LEFT JOIN t_town t ON tp.town_id = t.TOWN_ID LEFT JOIN t_sec_user su ON su.userId = u.agent_id ) where u.userid=#{playerId} and tp.player_id=#{playerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_player t SET t.level = #{level}, t.expiric_value = #{exp} WHERE t.player_id=#{playerId}

UPDATE t_player t SET t.attack = #{attack}, t.defense = #{defense}, t.life = #{life}, t.capture_attack = #{attack}, t.capture_defense = #{defense}, t.capture_life = #{life} WHERE t.player_id=#{playerId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.player_id AS playerId, p.compere_id AS compereId, su.userId AS managerId, su2.userId AS thirdlyAgentId, su3.userId AS secondaryAgentId, su4.userId AS primaryAgentId, su5.userId AS operatorId FROM t_player p, t_compere c, t_sec_user su, t_sec_user su2, t_sec_user su3, t_sec_user su4, t_sec_user su5, t_user u WHERE p.player_id = #{playerId} AND p.compere_id = c.compere_id AND c.agent_id = su.userId AND su.parent_id = su2.userId AND su2.parent_id = su3.userId AND su3.parent_id = su4.userId AND su4.parent_id = su5.userId AND c.compere_id = u.userid AND u.deprecated = 0
SELECT player_id FROM t_player WHERE promoter_id = #{playerId}

select card_id as cardId, card_pw as cardPw, status as status, player_id as playerId, use_time as useTime, money_type as moneyTime, price as price from t_biqi_cardid WHERE status=1 and player_id = #{playerId} ORDER BY use_time desc;
SELECT * FROM t_gift_room_card WHERE user_id=#{playerId} order by create_time desc LIMIT #{beginRowIndex},#{pageSize}
SELECT * FROM t_gift_room_card WHERE to_user_id=#{playerId} order by create_time desc LIMIT #{beginRowIndex},#{pageSize}

SELECT user_id as userId, order_id as orderId, create_time as createTime, money as money, surplus_money as surplusMonry, status as status, result as result FROM t_waiweiorder_history${i} WHERE user_id=#{playerId} order by id DESC LIMIT #{beginRowIndex},#{pageSize}
select userid from ims_tpuser WHERE id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bullfight_gameinfo (mid, sid, money, bycoins, freezemoney, exp, score, wintimes, losetimes, chip) VALUES (#{mid}, #{sid}, #{money}, #{bycoins}, #{freezemoney}, #{exp}, #{score}, #{wintimes}, #{losetimes}, #{chip})
